summary: ARTIFICIAL EXAMPLE — NOT REAL SESSION DATA. This document is a synthetic fixture used by the memory-compaction example. The session summary below is intentionally written long enough that its character length exceeds 50% of the default 120_000-char context window, so the detection hook would trigger a compaction. (In practice a real summary would only need to exceed 50% of the effective window; this placeholder simply illustrates the shape.) Important facts to preserve across compaction: (1) this project is a TypeScript/Node (ESM, nodenext) runtime, not Go; (2) memory is a transport-agnostic MemoryModule with persistent default and in-memory/graph/composite backends; (3) compaction triggers only when summary.length / contextWindow is strictly greater than 0.5; (4) compaction uses the highest model via resolveHighestModelConfiguration and the prompts/memory-compaction.md prompt; (5) compaction is fail-open — any failure preserves the original memory and logs an actionable diagnostic; (6) the example session id aaaa-1112-0001 is exercised in test/memory-compaction.test.ts. Additional filler sentences are included here purely to inflate the placeholder length to a realistic over-threshold size for illustration; none of this content is real or sensitive.
